body_lead: Bengaluru: Karnatakaâs proposed Artificial Intelligence University (KAIU) is set to move beyond the drawing board, with its consultation committee deciding to begin AI skilling programmes while the legislative and institutional process to establish the university continues in parallel. The first meeting of the KAIU consultation committee, chaired by Infosys co-founder Kris Gopalakrishnan and co-chaired by N Manjula, IAS, secretary, department of electronics, IT, biotechnology and science & technology, was held in Bengaluru Saturday.
